cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Not Until You Explain
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Before you catch that bus: you said work kept you till six. Why's your taxi receipt timed five?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll explain tomorrow. That's the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I'll drive you. What happened to that hour?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I left at five. I stopped somewhere before I came home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you home after you tell me where you stopped. Sit down; I've got all evening.

mechanism: A uses command of transport and departure to keep B present until the suspicious missing hour is explained.
confusable: Unlike curiosity alone, A removes the bus excuse and makes release contingent on accounting for the contradiction.
comparison: A taxi time and ride offer differ from a wedding booking and work departure.
seedUse: The seed's conditional ride and sit-down command already enact the S01 hierarchy while pursuing D122.
